evidence: The average growth rate of the ALD of NiS x is 0.50 ± 0.04 Å/cycle for the first 50 cycles. Beyond 50 cycles, a decrease in the growth rate was observed to be 0.20 ± 0.07 Å/cycle. AFM images of films grown on Si decrease in root-mean-square (RMS) surface roughness from 1.3, 0.66, and 0.56 nm for 50, 200, and 400 AB cycles, respectively.
